name: Mugen Kairou 1.5 ~Rensa~
source:
Welcome back… "Taro"…
The place I thought I found for myself at the end of a dream…
But it was just one of many possibilities.
That path, which seemed to stretch on forever…
Would not allow an end to come…
Once again today, the lady's "attentions" begin…

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=821450]getchu[/url]]
